cases.prompt: Make my friend's film portfolio feel like one continuous movie as you scroll
cases.why: the Parker site rules: SPEC from every message, low poly preview before renders, same-object hand-offs
reject: queuing final renders before a preview

cases.prompt: This section looks like a slideshow, fix it
cases.why: a section must be a thing happening, never cards that swap

cases.prompt: Put his film on the monitor in the render
cases.why: render the screen empty, export its quad, map the video in with matrix3d
reject: an absolutely positioned video laid over the render

cases.prompt: There's a weird doubling strip at the top when I scroll into the next scene
cases.why: generic section padding offset the pin; measure rects, zero padding, rerun full_bleed and walk_seams
reject: tweaking the transition timing without measuring
